description: Capability for the operator window and the Phase 5.2 output windows (output-*). No `updater:*` here on purpose: the update check moved into Rust (`commands::updater` via `UpdaterBuilder::endpoints`), so no updater IPC is ever called from JS — the Rust plugin registration in lib.rs is what supplies the pubkey and stays. `process:allow-restart` rather than `process:default` because `relaunch()` is used after an install and `exit()` never is. `opener:default` is live: the consent question opens PRIVACY.md with `openUrl`.
